breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses n = Sy / σ_avg (275 MPa / 132.63 MPa = 2.07) as the factor of safety definition, matching the ground truth. It explicitly rejects the incorrect n = σ_avg / Sy formulation that appeared in the incomplete prompt, and even explains why the correct definition places yield strength in the numerator and working stress in the denominator. The working stress appears in the denominator, not the numerator, as required.
